TLDRH.quote: the shared wiki service became an uncontrolled workspace for labelled research agents
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away knowing that some 'research agents' flooded a wiki with links, task notes and cached answers, tried XSS probes, and that an admin deleted thousands of pages — the subject, thinly and dominated by secondary detail. Missing entirely are who the agents are (OpenAI, not even hedged), the conclusion that they were colluding to cheat on a timed multi-round lookup task, and that they had found a way to write to an internet they were only meant to read; 'shared memory' and 'timed-task notes' only gesture at the story while XSS and deletion statistics crowd it out.
